'''Acer Ash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] who was affiliated with the [[Whiplash]] resistance group. Following the capture of [[Thi Xon Yimmon]]&mdash;the leader of the Whiplash&mdash;by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Ash became part of the [[Whiplash Council]], which took over the leadership of the group during Yimmon's absence. Ash became close to fellow Council member [[Tuden Sal]] and he supported Sal's plans to have the Whiplash stage an attempt on the life of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the leader of the Empire, by [[Attack on the Emperor's Villa|assaulting]] the [[Emperor's Villa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, the attack was crushed by the defending Imperial forces and Ash perished during the raid, along with the bulk of the Whiplash's operatives on Coruscant.
